**Best move:** Nd6+

**Main line:** Nd6+ Kb8 Nxc4 (or if cxd6, White is up a knight)

**Motif:** fork

**Explanation:**
The knight on e4 can jump to d6 with check, creating a royal fork—the move simultaneously attacks the king on c8 and the undefended queen on c4. After Black moves the king (Kb8 is forced to avoid further disaster), White simply captures the queen with Nxc4, winning decisive material. If Black blocks with cxd6 instead, White has still gained a full piece. This is a classic pattern: look for checks that hit an undefended piece at the same time.
